extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities by division.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate with a denominator of one.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship where the ratio between two quantities is constant.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The constant value of the ratio in a proportional relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be expressed as a fraction of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that cannot be expressed as a simple fraction.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The non-negative value of a number without regard to its sign.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest positive integer divisible by two or more numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Numerical Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A combination of numbers and operations without variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An algebraic equation forming a straight line when graphed.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical statement comparing two values using <, >, ≤, or ≥.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional plane formed by perpendicular x and y axes.

extracted_concepts.name: Polygon
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A closed two-dimensional shape with straight sides.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional object.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data collection.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The arithmetic average of a data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The middle value in an ordered data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The steepness of a line, representing the rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relation assigning exactly one output to each input.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose graph is a straight line, typically y = mx + b.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: In a right triangle, a² + b² = c².

extracted_concepts.name: Right Triangle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A triangle containing one 90-degree angle.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph displaying values for two variables as points.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruent Figures
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures that have the same shape and size.
